The '''2025–26 season''' was [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool Football Club]]'s 134th overall and their 64th consecutive season in the top flight of [[Football in England|English football]]. In addition to the [[2025–26 Premier League|domestic league]], the club also participated in the [[2025–26 FA Cup|FA Cup]], the [[2025–26 EFL Cup|EFL Cup]], the [[2025 FA Community Shield|FA Community Shield]] and the [[2025–26 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]].

On 30 May 2026, after a 5th place league finish and no silverware, the club announced that head coach [[Arne Slot]] had departed his role with immediate effect.<ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool FC statement |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-fc-statement-13 |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=30 May 2026}}</ref>

==First-team squad==
This was the first season since [[2015–16 Liverpool F.C. season|2015–16]] without [[Trent Alexander-Arnold]], the first since [[2020–21 Liverpool F.C. season|2020–21]] without [[Luis Díaz (footballer, born 1997)|Luis Díaz]] and the first since [[2019–20 Liverpool F.C. season|2019–20]] without [[Diogo Jota]], who died in a car accident on 3 July 2025.<ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool forward Diogo Jota dies in car crash |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cr4we9z2l42o |publisher=BBC Sport |date=3 July 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Diogo Jota: 1996-2025 |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/diogo-jota-1996-2025 |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=3 July 2025}}</ref> On 11 July 2025, Jota's squad number 20 was retired across all levels in his memory.<ref name="JotaNumber">{{cite news |title=Diogo Jota: Forever our number 20 |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/diogo-jota-forever-our-number-20 |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=11 July 2025}}</ref>

==Pre-season and friendlies==
On 31 March 2025, Liverpool announced they would return to Asia for a pre-season tour, with one friendly confirmed against [[AC Milan]] in [[Hong Kong]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool to return to Asia for 2025 pre-season tour |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-return-asia-2025-pre-season-tour |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=31 March 2025}}</ref> A week later, the second friendly of the tour was confirmed to be against [[Yokohama F. Marinos]] in [[Yokohama]], marking their first ever pre-season tour in [[Japan]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool to face Yokohama F. Marinos in second game of pre-season tour in Asia |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-face-yokohama-f-marinos-second-game-pre-season-tour-asia |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=10 April 2025}}</ref> An extra friendly ahead of the Asian tour against [[Preston North End F.C.|Preston North End]] was confirmed on 5 June 2025.<ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool to face Preston North End in first pre-season game |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-face-preston-north-end-first-pre-season-game |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=5 June 2025}}</ref> Five days later, a double-header at [[Anfield]] against [[Athletic Bilbao]] was added to conclude the pre-season fixtures.<ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool to face Athletic Club in pre-season double-header at Anfield |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-face-athletic-club-pre-season-double-header-anfield |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=10 June 2025}}</ref> On 20 July 2025, a [[Behind closed doors (sport)|behind-closed-doors]] friendly was played against [[Stoke City F.C.|Stoke City]] at the [[Liverpool Training Centre]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Match report: Nunez hits hat-trick as Liverpool beat Stoke in behind-closed-doors friendly |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/match-report-nunez-hits-hat-trick-liverpool-beat-stoke-behind-closed-doors-friendly |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=20 July 2025}}</ref>

===FA Cup===
{{main|2025–26 FA Cup}}

As a Premier League side, Liverpool entered the FA Cup in the third round, and were drawn at home to League One club [[Barnsley F.C.|Barnsley]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Premier League and EFL Championship clubs join the Emirates FA Cup following the draw |url=https://www.thefa.com/news/2025/dec/08/emirates-fa-cup-third-round-proper-draw-20250812 |publisher=The Football Association |date=8 December 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool to host Barnsley in FA Cup third round |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-host-barnsley-fa-cup-third-round |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=8 December 2025}}</ref> In the fourth round, they were drawn at home to Premier League side [[Brighton & Hove Albion F.C.|Brighton & Hove Albion]].<ref>{{cite news |title=The draw for the Emirates FA Cup fourth round proper of 2025-26 has been made |url=https://www.thefa.com/news/2026/jan/12/emirates-fa-cup-fourth-round-proper-draw-made-20261201 |publisher=The Football Association |date=12 January 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool to face Brighton in FA Cup fourth round |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-face-brighton-fa-cup-fourth-round |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=12 January 2026}}</ref> They were then drawn away to Premier League side [[Wolverhampton Wanderers F.C.|Wolverhampton Wanderers]] in the fifth round,<ref>{{cite news |title=The Emirates FA Cup fifth round draw has been made with eight ties at this stage |url=https://www.thefa.com/news/2026/feb/16/emirates-fa-cup-fifth-round-draw-20261602 |publisher=The Football Association |date=16 February 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool to face Wolves in FA Cup fifth round |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-face-wolves-fa-cup-fifth-round |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=16 February 2026}}</ref> and away to Premier League club [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]] in the quarter-finals.<ref>{{cite news |title=The draw for the last eight of the Emirates FA Cup 2025-26 season has been made |url=https://www.thefa.com/news/2026/mar/09/emirates-fa-cup-quarter-final-draw-has-been-made-20260903 |publisher=The Football Association |date=9 March 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool to face Manchester City in FA Cup quarter-finals |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-face-manchester-city-fa-cup-quarter-finals {{main|2025–26 EFL Cup}}

===UEFA Champions League===
{{main|2025–26 UEFA Champions League}}

As the reigning champions in the [[2024–25 Premier League|Premier League]], Liverpool entered the UEFA Champions League in the league phase.

====League phase====
{{main|2025–26 UEFA Champions League league phase}}

The league phase draw was held on 28 August 2025. Liverpool were drawn at home to [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]], [[Atlético Madrid]], [[PSV Eindhoven]], [[Qarabağ FK|Qarabağ]], and away to [[Inter Milan]], [[Eintracht Frankfurt]], [[Olympique de Marseille|Marseille]] and [[Galatasaray S.K. ====Knockout phase====
{{main|2025–26 UEFA Champions League knockout phase}}

As a top-eight team in the league phase, Liverpool entered the knockout phase directly into the round of 16.

=====Round of 16=====
The round of 16 draw was held on 27 February 2026. Liverpool were drawn against Turkish champions [[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]], with the first leg away and the second leg at home.<ref name="UCLKOdraw">{{cite news |title=Champions League round of 16 draw: Paris Saint-Germain vs Chelsea, Real Madrid face Man City |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/02a2-20067c4f43b2-99cd5d219005-1000 |publisher=UEFA |date=27 February 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Liverpool to face Galatasaray in Champions League last 16 |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/liverpool-face-galatasaray-champions-league-last-16 |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=27 February 2026}}</ref>

=====Quarter-finals=====
The quarter-finals draw were automatically determined after the round of 16 draw on 27 February 2026. As a result, Liverpool faced French champions and defending European champions [[Paris Saint-Germain FC|Paris Saint-Germain]], with the first leg away and the second leg at home.<ref name="UCLKOdraw" /><ref>{{cite news |title=Champions League quarter-final details: Liverpool to face Paris Saint-Germain |url=https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/champions-league-quarter-final-details-liverpool-face-paris-saint-germain |publisher=Liverpool F.C. |date=18 March 2026}}</ref>
